reference.notes:
I implemented the spec in `src/index.ts`, and every test now passes: 15 of 15 in the public suite and 25 of 25 in the private suite.

- **`readStatus`** cleans the stored value as the spec describes: it trims the ends, lowercases it, and turns every run of spaces, `-` and `_` into one space. It then returns the cleaned text if it is one of the five statuses, or the status a known old spelling maps to. Anything else reads as `null`; there is no fuzzy or partial matching. The lookups use `Set` and `Map` rather than plain objects, so values like `constructor` or `__proto__` also read as `null`.
- **`writeStatus`** accepts only an exact status value, without cleaning it first. Anything else, including old spellings and values with different capitals or padding, throws an error that quotes the value exactly as given.
- **`readStatuses`** reads each row with `readStatus` and collects the original stored values that came back as no status. Each one is listed once, exactly as stored, in plain JavaScript string sort order.

None of the tests contradicted the spec, so I didn't have to bend the code to fit any of them.

Failing tests: none
